title: NightWatch incident Agent usage — frontend profile
description: Existing API.md section 6 incident.usage fields. A cumulative snapshot for one incident, replaced on refresh, never added to previous snapshots. Missing usage means unavailable; do not fabricate zeroes.

input_tokens.description: All input tokens, including cached tokens.

cached_tokens.description: Subset of input_tokens served from prompt cache. Must be <= input_tokens; enforce this cross-field constraint in code.

output_tokens.description: Reported output tokens. Do not add a separate reasoning count to this value.
